capabilities.meaning: Retain or copy exact source bytes without interpreting unknown layouts.
Report known structure and unknown inventory without claiming complete semantics.
Verify framing, byte ranges, checksums, and named roots that the reader understands.
Verify every meaning-bearing item required by the selected semantic scope.
Derive canonical state only from records whose exact schema and root protocols are supported.
Admit authority only after complete required semantic verification.
Execute behavior only from admitted, completely understood authority.

migration-required.meaning: A compatible reader or explicit receipt-bearing migration is required before this semantic operation may continue.

preserve-only.meaning: Exact well-formed bytes may be retained or copied, but no semantic claim may be folded or admitted.

read.meaning: All material required by the selected reader profile is structurally and semantically understood.

read-degraded.meaning: The reader completed only its declared bounded operation and reports that semantic verification is incomplete.

reject.meaning: Structural corruption or missing required material prevents even the selected bounded operation.
